run_motion_editor: run the ai4animation motion editor demo with the Cranberry dataset and model
create_motion_editor_entity: create a MotionEditor entity in the ai4animation scene using AI4Animation.Scene.AddEntity
configure_dataset_modules: configure a Dataset with RootModule, MotionModule, ContactModule, GuidanceModule, and MirrorModule lambdas
setup_contact_module: setup a ContactModule with ankle and foot ball contact points and threshold values
set_camera_target: set the standalone camera target to the MotionEditor entity using AI4Animation.Standalone.Camera.SetTarget
